name: Keystroke dynamics
plain: Records key press and release times to build a typing rhythm profile.
meaning: Dwell times (key held) and flight times (between keys) for password and free text identify people with 1 to 5% error. Persists across devices and accounts, used for continuous authentication and fraud.

steps: Listen to keydown and keyup on fields

limits.headline: Can time your key presses to learn your typing rhythm
limits.user_action: You type in a box on the page
can: Time how long you hold each key
Build a typing profile that picks you out with about 1 to 5% error
Match the same person on other devices or accounts
cannot: Work if you paste text instead of typing it
See what you type in other tabs or apps
Be switched off by clearing cookies

story.what_it_is: A script records when each key goes down and up, to build a profile of your typing rhythm.
story.for_you: You never see it. Everyone types with their own rhythm, like a signature. A page that can see key timing can learn yours and later tell if it is you or someone else typing.
story.for_makers: Banks and fraud teams use typing rhythm as a quiet second check that you are really you. Some sites use it to spot bots that type too evenly. Critics point out it is also tracking of a body trait.

use_cases.example: A bank compares how you type your password with your usual rhythm, and asks for more proof if it looks different.
A bot detector sees login typing that is too even and fast, and blocks it as a script.
An online exam service checks that the same person who started the course is the one typing the test.
A company portal uses typing rhythm as a hidden second factor for staff accounts.
A social site spots a bot farm because all fake accounts type with the same machine like pattern.
A browser game with chat checks for macro or script input that types perfect timing.
A tracker could link two visits by typing style, which is why privacy groups raise concerns.

technical_bounds: Cannot read keys outside the page or in other iframes
Password fields still emit events to the page

value.legit_uses: Fraud detection, account takeover defense, typing tests
value.abuse: Cross-device identity tracking and profiling, user re-identification
